title: Voy Means I Am Going
voice_notes: Warm, patient teacher. One voice. Brian v3. English prompts use language_code en; Spanish reveals use language_code es. Avoid Language Transfer branding.

segments.say: Spanish gives you one tiny word for I go and I am going.
Voy can mean I go, or I am going. Context does the work.
segments.show:
voy =
I go / I am going

segments.say: To make it negative, park no in front.
Now say: I am not going now.
Good. You changed the whole sentence by moving one small no.

caption: Voy means I go or I am going. Add ahora for now, and park no in front for the negative: no voy ahora.
